sources_read.title: Claude Code v2.1.139 release
key_facts: Adds agent view Research Preview via `claude agents`.
Adds `/goal` command for completion-condition driven work across turns.
Adds plugin details, hook args exec form, PostToolUse continueOnBlock, MCP reconnect and environment improvements.
Adds subagent tracing headers and OTEL agent_id / parent_agent_id attributes.

sources_read.title: Anthropic financial-services repository
key_facts: README describes reference agents, skills, and data connectors for financial-services workflows.

GitHub API showed 20,294 stars and 2,670 forks when checked on 2026-05-12.
